request.style: English, contemporary gospel mass choir, a male lead preaching the verses and the choir answering, Hammond organ, piano, bass and live drums, mid-tempo groove rising into a shout, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Have you not known, have you not heard
The everlasting God, the Lord
He does not faint, he does not grow weary
His understanding is unsearchable

[Verse]
He gives power to the faint
And to the one with no might he increases strength
Even the young shall faint and be weary
And the young men shall fall exhausted

[Chorus]
But they who wait for the Lord
Shall renew their strength
They shall mount up with wings like eagles
They shall run and not be weary
They shall walk and not faint

[Bridge]
Wait on the Lord, wait on the Lord
Wings like eagles, wings like eagles

[Chorus]
But they who wait for the Lord
Shall renew their strength
They shall mount up with wings like eagles
They shall run and not be weary
They shall walk and not faint
